name: pcie_tl_ep_regs
desc: PCIe transaction-layer endpoint: DMA control, address and length, link status, completer ID, BAR0, TLP counters.

registers.name: DMA_ADDR_LO
registers.desc: DMA host address [31:0] (a write reloads the address)

registers.name: DMA_ADDR_HI
registers.desc: DMA host address [63:32] (a write reloads the address)

fields.name: MEM_EN
fields.desc: memory space enabled by the host

fields.name: BUS_MASTER
fields.desc: bus mastering enabled by the host

fields.name: SF_LEVEL
fields.desc: words in the DMA source FIFO

registers.name: BAR0
registers.desc: BAR0 as programmed by the host
